newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus t-bill rate dips slightly to 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus t-bill rate dips slightly to 5.49 pct.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank sold 14 million pounds ($27.4 million) of 91-day treasury bills on Wednesday with an average yield of 5.49 percent compared with 5.50 percent at the previous auction on May 28, the bank said.
Competitive and non-competitive bids for bills totalled 17 million pounds compared with 20 million pounds initially offered by the central bank.
The yields of accepted bids ranged from 5.50 percent to 5.48 percent. ($=0.511 pounds)
